jobs.description: At Freddie Mac, our mission of Making Home Possible is what motivates us, and it’s at the core of everything we do. Since our charter in 1970, we have made home possible for more than 90 million families across the country. Join an organization where your work contributes to a greater purpose. Position Overview Multifamily Capital Markets is seeking an exceptionally curious, analytical, and driven professional to help identify, prioritize, and deliver the initiatives that can most improve the business. This is a rare opportunity to develop a broad view across the Multifamily Capital Markets organization, including loan pricing, pipeline risk management, portfolio management, securitization, credit-risk transfer, operations, and technology. You will work directly with a Capital Markets leader who brings deep Multifamily expertise, extensive Wall Street markets and product experience, and a track record of developing innovative solutions to complex financial problems. Together, you will examine how the business operates, identify its highest-impact opportunities, challenge existing assumptions, and develop solutions from first principles. This is a hands-on role combining original problem-solving, quantitative analysis, and end-to-end initiative delivery. You will research unfamiliar topics; analyze financial, market, and operational data; build analytical models and lightweight Python prototypes; test hypotheses; frame business questions; and develop fact-based recommendations. You will write the memos and presentations that move decisions forward, document conclusions and requirements, coordinate contributors, maintain project plans and follow-ups, and drive multiple initiatives through organizational and technical roadblocks from initial idea through implementation. This role is designed for someone who enjoys learning unfamiliar topics, solving difficult problems, and taking ownership of outcomes. We are less interested in finding someone who has seen every situation before and more interested in finding someone who can quickly understand a new problem, develop a fact-based view, and help drive it to resolution. Exceptional candidates often demonstrate impact that exceeds what would normally be expected given their years of experience. The successful candidate will be expected to operate with substantial independence and combine analytical depth with exceptional conscientiousness and execution discipline. The role requires someone who takes ownership, maintains momentum across multiple complex initiatives, pursues unresolved issues, and keeps driving until decisions are made and outcomes are delivered. Our Impact Multifamily Capital Markets sits at the intersection of markets, products, risk, capital, and the economics of the Multifamily business. The department prices loans, manages pipeline and portfolio exposures, accesses the capital markets through securitization and credit-risk transfer, and manages retained investments. The Strategy and Priorities function takes a department-wide view. We identify the questions and opportunities with the greatest potential impact, develop a clear view of the economics and trade-offs, and work across functions to help turn the best ideas into durable business improvements. This role will help department leadership: Identify the opportunities and problems with the greatest potential impact on the business. Create an integrated view across products, risks, economics, and Capital Markets functions. Improve transparency into business performance, risk, and management trade-offs. Move promising ideas from concept through implementation. Ensure important initiatives have clear ownership, decisions, and follow-through. Your Impact In this role, you will: Help leadership prioritize initiatives based on business value, urgency, complexity, and resource requirements. Turn broad ideas and unresolved business issues into defined objectives, analyses, workstreams, and decisions. Examine problems from first principles, test assumptions, and develop fact-based recommendations. Coordinate work across Capital Markets teams and partners in Finance, Risk, Operations, Technology, and other parts of the company. Establish owners, milestones, dependencies, and decision points; anticipate roadblocks; pursue open items; and keep initiatives moving toward resolution. Gather and reconcile information, analyze financial, market, and operational data, build quantitative models, and identify gaps or conflicting conclusions. Write concise, decision-ready memos and presentations that explain the issue, analysis, alternatives, economics, recommendation, and required actions. Translate agreed-upon approaches into clear business requirements and implementation plans. Remain engaged through delivery while ensuring that the appropriate business or operating function owns the resulting capability. Develop analyses and Python prototypes when useful to test an idea, demonstrate an approach, or clarify business and technical requirements. Take ownership of issues that do not fit neatly within existing teams or processes and help drive them from initial question through implemented solution. The candidate will be expected to frame issues independently, work directly with senior leaders and subject-matter experts, resolve cross-functional obstacles, and maintain ownership and momentum across multiple complex initiatives with limited direction. Qualifications Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant experience. 2-4 years of experience in capital markets, financial services, portfolio management, securitization, quantitative analysis, business analysis, product development, initiative delivery, consulting, strategy, or related analytical fields. Familiarity with fixed income, mortgages, derivatives, hedging, credit-risk transfer, or asset-liability management is beneficial but not required. Demonstrated ability to analyze data and working proficiency with Python, SQL, Excel. Demonstrated conscientiousness, ownership, and follow-through while managing several concurrent projects. Understanding of P&L, financial analysis, market-risk measurement, capital allocation, or financial reporting is preferred. Advanced degree in finance, economics, quantitative finance, business, engineering, or a related field is preferred. Keys to Success in This Role: Curiosity: Wants to understand how the business actually works and does not stop at the first explanation. Enjoys learning unfamiliar topics and developing expertise in new areas. A First-Principles Thinker: Separates fundamental objectives and economics from inherited processes, assumptions, and conventional wisdom. A Self-Starter: Does not wait for detailed instructions. Identifies opportunities, develops approaches independently, and maintains momentum through ambiguity and competing priorities. An Owner: Treats commitments as personal responsibilities. Closes loops, follows through on open issues, and remains engaged until outcomes are delivered. Organized and Conscientious: Can coordinate multiple initiatives simultaneously, establish structure where none exists, track commitments, identify roadblocks, and ensure important details do not fall through the cracks. Quantitatively Capable: Can independently analyze financial data, develop models, and build prototypes that test an idea or demonstrate how a solution should work. Confident and Collaborative: Comfortable working directly with senior leaders and subject-matter experts. Able to ask questions, challenge assumptions constructively, and build alignment across teams. Conscientious and Relentless: Produces accurate, complete work; anticipates roadblocks; and persistently finds a path forward when projects stall. Direct and Collaborative: Raises difficult issues constructively and builds productive working relationships. Current Freddie Mac employees please apply through the internal career site. Please contact us to request accommodation. A safe and secure environment is critical to Freddie Mac’s business. Employees exercise this responsibility by executing against policies and procedures and adhering to privacy & security obligations as required via training programs. Company Introduction
Coupang is reimagining the shopping experience with the goal of wowing each customer from the instant they open the Coupang app to the moment an order is delivered to their door.
Our services in Taiwan include “Rocket Delivery” which offers next-day delivery for a wide selection of items at affordable prices, “Rocket Overseas” which offers free international delivery on millions of best-selling products from Korea, the U.S., and beyond.
We are looking for talents to help us lead Coupang’s expansion in Taiwan. This is an exceptional opportunity to become a part of Coupang’s growth in Taiwan and create a world where our customers wonder, “How did I ever live without Coupang?”
Role Overview
This role will be seated in our third-party (3P) Marketplace leadership group in Taiwan, reporting to the Head of Marketplace Business Domain. you will be responsible for our sales development and category management teams onboarding anchor sellers based on each category vertical integration with the Taiwan market, and growing sellers to succeed at Coupang Marketplace in Taiwan. In this role, you will build and manage a high performing team that drives revenue growth through best-in-class seller experiences. This role offers a unique opportunity to build and lead a marketplace category management team from the ground up and make a significant impact on Coupang’s growth in Taiwan.

Manage
Category Management
division to develop sellers and product selection for each category, carry out category’s P&L and sales performance.
Partner with the
Seller Acquisition
team to onboard anchor sellers and develop a full spectrum of strategic seller profile, build seller success for every category.
Support
Head of Marketplace Business’s
leadership, provide category management direction, strategies, guidance, and support to foster a high-performance culture in a high growth phase.
Establish clear team objectives and ensure all members understand their roles in achieving these targets.
Regularly assess team performance, offer constructive feedback, and implement strategies for continuous improvement and high performance.
Identify process and policy gaps within the teams and conduct effective communication or project sessions to enhance competencies and professional growth of Coupang Marketplace.
Oversee daily operations, ensuring processes run smoothly, efficiency and align with organizational standards and goals.
Basic Qualifications
15+ years of experience in e-commerce, digital marketplace management, distribution, or related fields, with a proven track record of scaling 3P seller business. Demonstrated success in building and leading high-performing teams.
Has experience of leadership roles at 3P Marketplace platforms in Taiwan is a plus.
Comprehensive understanding of e-commerce ecosystems, including seller dynamics and an ability to leverage this knowledge for strategic growth.
Knowledge of logistics, fulfillment processes, and supply chain operations, particularly 3P marketplace environments.
Proven ability to negotiate and foster long-term partnerships with 3P sellers, suppliers and other stakeholders, driving mutual growth and customer satisfaction.
Strong leadership skills with experience managing cross functional teams to execute complex marketplace projects effectively.
Exceptional analytical and problem-solving abilities, with the capacity to leverage data insights to inform business decisions, improve processes and optimize team performance.
A strong commitment to delivering exceptional results for customers, aligning seller operations with the company’s customer-first (wow the customer) approach.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, verbal Mandarin language is mandatory.

As such, we greatly value communication skills.

jobs.description: Für unseren Standort in Lahntal suchen wir derzeit nach einem Teamleiter in der Instandhaltung (m/w/d)! Unser Wartungs- und Instandhaltungsteam (Reliability Maintenance Engineering Team oder RME-Team) ist der Kern von Amazons Engagement für Innovation. Amazon entwickelt sich weiter und dieses Team sorgt dafür, dass dies auch die von uns verwendeten Technologien und Tools tun. In dieser Rolle hilfst Du uns, der Entwicklung einen Schritt voraus zu bleiben. Du setzt die neuesten Technologien ein und identifizierst neue, effiziente Arbeitsmethoden. In dieser Rolle achtest Du genau auf unsere Prozesse und trägst dazu bei, dass wir unsere höchsten Sicherheitsstandards befolgen und weiter erhöhen. Key job responsibilities - Best Practice und Unterstützen im Bedienen von Geräten und Anlagen mit den höchsten Sicherheitsstandards - Verfolgen der Geräteleistung durch visuelle Prüfungen, zustandsorientierte Überwachung und vorbeugende Wartungsmaßnahmen und Einplanen zusätzlicher Wartung je nach Bedarf - Verantwortung für das technische Team während seiner Schicht und dessen Unterstützung und Weiterentwicklung - Lösung von Problemen an Anlagen, um Betriebsausfallzeiten zu reduzieren und die schnellstmögliche Abfertigung von Paketen zu ermöglichen - Unterstützung bei der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung von Systemen und Standardisierung von Prozessen im ganzen EU-Netzwerk A day in the life Du betreust ein Instandhaltungsteam innerhalb einer Schicht und sorgst dafür, dass alle Mitarbeitenden die erforderlichen Werkzeuge zur Verfügung haben und diese einwandfrei funktionieren. Das beinhaltet die Überwachung von Prozessen, damit Vorschriften und Richtlinien befolgt werden, ebenso wie die Gewährleistung der Durchführung vorbeugender Wartungsmaßnahmen, um die Betriebszeit unserer Anlagen zu maximieren. Durch Deine Beobachtungen während der Schichtarbeit machst Du Verbesserungsvorschläge, um unsere Systeme noch effizienter und produktiver zu gestalten, und setzt diese Verbesserungen EU-weit um. Außerdem nutzt Du Tools wie SCADA zur Überwachung von Prozessen, um deren Leistungsfähigkeit zu gewährleisten, und unterstützt administrative Aufgaben in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Deinen Führungskräften. Du arbeitest vor Ort in einem unserer Logistikzentren. Du arbeitest in Schichtmodellen, die Nächte und Wochenenden umfassen können. Mit den Kenntnissen und Erfahrungen, die Du sammelst, wirst Du Dich zu weiteren Führungspositionen weiterentwickeln. About the team Unser Wartungs- und Instandhaltungsteam (Reliability Maintenance Engineering Team oder RME-Team) sorgt dafür, dass unsere Geräte und Ausstattung jederzeit optimal funktionieren. Wir sind ein Team von Techniker:innen und Ingenieur:innen, das aus hervorragenden Teamplayern besteht und von erfahrenen Führungskräften geleitet wird. Wir arbeiten gemeinsam daran, die Geräte in unserem gesamten globalen Netzwerk von Fulfillment-Centern zu warten, zu reparieren und ihre Fehler zu beheben. Einige unserer Mitarbeiter:innen sind Führungskräfte, die das Team bei der Arbeit an spannender, innovativer Technologie beaufsichtigen – die es teilweise nur bei Amazon gibt. Von der Installation automatisierter Verpackungssysteme bis hin zur Beaufsichtigung der allgemeinen Wartungsarbeiten eines Standorts sowie der Reparatur von für den Vertrieb wesentlichen Geräten wickelt unser Team einen Großteil der technischen Aufgaben bei Amazon ab. Unter anderem sorgt es auch dafür, dass Gebäude weiterhin den rechtlichen Auflagen entsprechen, damit alle sicher bleiben und unsere Standorte mit maximaler Effizienz betrieben werden. Es gibt zahlreiche Aufstiegschancen im RME-Team selbst ebenso wie im gesamten Amazon-Unternehmen. jobs.description: OVERVIEW Experience a perfect blend of deliberate purpose and clear-eyed vision. GENERAL SUMMARY & SCOPE The Arch Expert (AE) is responsible for maximizing sales in the Benefit brand by engaging guests to determine their individual needs, assisting guests in the selection and purchase of merchandise and performing short services, including eyebrow/facial waxing and tinting. They represent the image, products, and culture of the brand to the Ulta Beauty guest and support the Experience Manager (EM) through a focus on performance (service/retail sales and in-store events), people (guest service), and process (operating procedures and compliance standards). This position requires an active license in Esthetics or Cosmetology (as required by law), exceptional guest service, and the aptitude to learn and communicate product knowledge. PRINCIPAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES (*Essential Job Functions) The Brow Waxing Expert is a champion of Ulta Beauty’s mission, vision and values, and should demonstrate them skillfully and consistently by performing the following duties and responsibilities of the position (as well as all other projects/duties as assigned): Performance Meet or exceed Benefit brand sales and service goals,and contribute to meeting or exceeding the store’s goals related to retail and service sales, guest loyalty (including credit), omni-channel, and retail shrink as set by Ulta Beauty. Ensure each guest receives exceptional service by greeting and engaging every guest, personalizing service to their needs, and recommending complementary products, samples, and services. Perform makeup applications, skincare analysis, and product demonstrations with guests to drive sales and guest service experience. Perform short services at the Brow Bar, including (but not limited to), eyebrow and facial waxing, tweezing, eyebrow tinting, strip lash applications, and threading in accordance with all of Ulta Beauty’s policies and procedures. Use appointment book or system to book guests’ appointments for initial services, return services, and events. Meet average sales per labor hour and sales to service ratio goal. Take the initiative to stay informed regarding new and existing industry trends, products, and services during work time, and be knowledgeable about the ingredients and benefits of these trends, products, and services to better serve guests. Maintain prompt, regular attendance. People Contribute to an inclusive environment that supports teammates, peers, and the internal and external guests served. Regularly participate in ongoing Benefit and Ulta Beauty training, including training parties, team meetings, and brand and category education, to enable continuous professional development and drive sales performance. Build and maintain strong customer relationships and an active clientele portfolio for Benefit brand services. Maintain strong relationships with Benefit brand partners through participation in required trainings and the execution of in store events and promotions. Create and maintain partnerships with Prestige consultants and salon professionals to promote teamwork and a high level of customer service. Share the benefits of the guest loyalty program, including credit and the Ulta Beauty app, with guests on the salesfloor. Collaborate with managers and associates throughout the store to help grow the business. Process Be knowledgeable of and ensure compliance with Ulta Beauty’s policies, procedures, and standards. Follow all safety, sanitation, and hygienic procedures before, during and after services; always ensure compliance with state board guidelines. Adhere to the Ulta Beauty and Benefit brand dress code, including wearing brand assets as directed. Drive sales by keeping the Brow Bar area replenished, signed and faced, and ensuring testers are available and maintained in compliance with hygiene standards, as well as any additional assigned area. Communicate supply needs to the store management team and brand representatives in a timely manner to ensure guest-readiness at all times. Maintain outstanding store operational standards, including cleanliness of the Brow Bar, and any additional assigned area including, the salesfloor, restrooms, cashwrap, backroom, and break area. Participate in completing merchandise resets, planograms, marketing displays, physical inventory procedures, and processing shipment using the Benefit brand’s and Ulta Beauty’s technology and best practices. Protect company assets by following loss prevention best practices and providing exceptional guest service. Execute other operational tasks as directed. Continuous coordination and manipulation of objects during shift If an associate has a disability that prevents them from performing an essential function of the job, the Company will engage in the interactive process with the associate to determine whether there is a reasonable accommodation that will enable the associate to perform the essential functions of the job. The pay range for this position is $15.00 - $23.00/ Hour. Exact pay will be based on factors including, but not limited to relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, level, shift, geographic location, and business and organizational needs. Eligible associates may also earn overtime pay as required by applicable law and tips paid by service guests. Full-time positions are eligible for paid time off, health, dental, vision, life, and disability benefits. Part-time positions are eligible for dental, vision, life, and disability benefits. For additional information concerning our benefits, visit our Benefits and Career Development page: https://learn.bswift.com/ulta ABOUT At Ulta Beauty (NASDAQ: ULTA), the possibilities are beautiful . Ulta Beauty is the largest North American beauty retailer and the premier beauty destination for cosmetics, fragrance, skin care products, hair care products and salon services. We bring possibilities to life through the power of beauty each and every day in our stores and online with more than 25,000 products from approximately 500 well-established and emerging beauty brands across all categories and price points, including Ulta Beauty’s own private label. Ulta Beauty also offers a full-service salon in every store featuring—hair, skin, brow, and make-up services.
